verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right flow (logo, product, headline, CTA), but the legal disclaimer is far too large and competes with the body copy. The SUNSET SALE badge is shrunk to an unreadable sliver, a stray red fragment floats between elements, and the three badges are microscopic. B is worse: the SUNSET SALE ribbon is cut off at the right edge, the broken-image placeholder collides with the legal text, the logo and badges are tiny and scattered, and the centred, wrapped headline is crammed against the left edge.
